thread:
zhou: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — recurring OOM pattern looks like heap fragmentation + slow GC on long-lived KV caches. Can owners confirm remediation plan/owners/timelines?
priya: I'm volunteering to lead the profiling work. Plan: enable jemalloc stats + heap prof on a couple canaries, then run synthetic workload to reproduce. Targeting data by Wed EOD. :white_check_mark:
mike: I'll take limits + runtime knobs. Thinking per-model soft limits + abort-on-OOM fallback. I'll sketch PR for `runtime/config` with `kv_soft_limit_mb` and `kv_compact_interval_s`. ETA Fri COB.
zhou: Thanks. Can you add telemetry metric names you'll emit so we can hook alerts?
mike: Sure. I'll emit `runtime.kv.fragmentation_ratio`, `runtime.kv.live_bytes`, `runtime.kv.retained_bytes`. Alert when fragmentation_ratio > 0.65 for 10m.
eva: On GC side I'll try bumping compaction frequency on the canaries and test impact on latency tail. Also want to test alternative allocators (jemalloc tcache tweaks). Will do A/B over next two days.
priya: Repro steps I'm planning: 1) start canary with 50k small-cache entries, 2) run mixed inference load (p50 token len 128) for 6h, 3) collect jemalloc_mallctl snapshot every 30m + heap prof on OOM. Will paste commands once scripted.
zhou: Great. For ownership: profiling = priya, runtime knobs + PR = mike, GC experiments = eva. Someone to own rollout/monitoring and alert updates?
priya: I can own the alert wiring once metrics are emitted. Will add runbook snippet in monitoring repo.
mike: I'll open the PR for config + fallback and add a small unit test. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/452 (draft).
eva: Quick note: in logs yesterday we saw many small allocs (~64-512B) across backends — fragmentation is likely across arenas. Suggest we include per-arena stats in the snapshot.
priya: Good call — I'll add `jemalloc.stats.arenas` output to the snapshot script.
zhou: Timeline recap: profiling results Wed EOD (priya), runtime PR by Fri COB (mike), GC experiments complete by Fri EOD (eva), alert + runbook by next Tue (priya). Is that workable?
mike: Works for me. If experiments show regression we'll pause rollout.
eva: Agree. I'll post results as comments in the PR and call out latency diffs.
eng-sre-bot: Incident note created: #INC-2026-heap-frag-triage.automated (linked to postmortem).
zhou: Thanks all. One last ask — include a short log snippet of the OOM inside the PR so reviewers can see reproducer trace. Example: ```OOM: runtime: out of memory after 6h; retained_bytes=1.2GB; fragmentation_ratio=0.72```
priya: Will add that. Also starting nightly regression job after fixes to ensure pattern doesn't recur.
zhou: Perfect. I'll schedule a 30m sync Tue 10am to verify rollouts and close action items. :calendar:
priya: Added to calendar.
mike: Added.
eva: Added.
zhou: Closing for now — I'll update the postmortem doc with owners/timelines. Thanks! :tada:
